title: Hidden Gems Beer Tasting Tour
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step off the beaten path and discover the city’s best-kept secrets on this guided beer walking tour. Over the course of three tucked-away stops, you’ll taste 8 unique beers that showcase the area’s brewing creativity—ranging from crisp lagers to bold, hoppy IPAs and rich seasonal specialties.

At one stop, you’ll even get to pour your own pint (yep, you’re the bartender now). And because great beer deserves great food, our second stop includes a taco of your choice to keep you fueled for the rest of the tastings! 

Each stop has its own vibe, its own flavors, and its own stories—making this the perfect way to sip, snack, and explore a few hidden gems with friends.

At the end of the tour your guides will provide recommendations of other great places to try beer in San Diego. We are local to the area and can offer other suggestions as well! This tour is great for beer lovers both visiting San Diego or locals looking to get out and have some fun!
